I saw a young boy standing before me with utmost politeness. Addressing me as uncle he said that his parents were calling me. I came out of my house and saw an elderly man and a woman. Addressing me as bhaiya the woman asked if I didn't recognize him. She added that she was Salma (or, She introduced herself as Salma) and said that they had looked for me everywhere but had not found me. I exclaimed in wonder that it was a great surprise.
